items.title: What Could Netflix (NFLX) Gain From Owning The Radford Studio Center?
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is in advanced talks to acquire the Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles, according to recent reports. The Radford Studio Center is a long established Hollywood production lot that currently hosts multiple television and film projects. This would be Netflix's first purchase of a full scale studio campus in California, shifting it from tenant to owner operator. items.title: Netflix closing on Radford Studio Center after Goldman Sachs’ $380M credit bid
items.summary: Hackman Capital's Michael Hackman and Radford Studio Center (Hackman Capital)Netflix is closing on Michael Hackman’s Radford Studio Center after a Goldman Sachs-led lender syndicate officially took over the Studio City lot. At an auction Tuesday, held outside of a courthouse in Pomona, the studio lot reverted back to the lenders after a call for offers opened at $380 million.
